import pandas as pd

months = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun",
          "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"]
values = [16167, 14906, 18208, 18817, 17428, 13933,
          22968, 32042, 25514, 30339, 75334, 41153]

revenue = pd.Series(values, index=months)
best_month = revenue.idxmax()
share = revenue / revenue.sum()

products = pd.DataFrame({
    "name": ["Cast Iron Skillet 26cm", "Burr Coffee Grinder", "2-Person Dome Tent"],
    "unit_price": [39, 129, 149],
    "unit_cost": [17.45, 76.99, 83.09],
})
margin = products["unit_price"] - products["unit_cost"]

checks.test: isinstance(revenue, pd.Series) and list(revenue.index) == months and int(revenue['Nov']) == 75334
isinstance(share, pd.Series) and round(float(share.sum()), 6) == 1.0 and round(float(share['Nov']), 4) == 0.2305
isinstance(products, pd.DataFrame) and products.shape == (3, 3) and set(products.columns) == {'name', 'unit_price', 'unit_cost'}
isinstance(margin, pd.Series) and [round(float(x), 2) for x in margin] == [21.55, 52.01, 65.91]
